verdict.rationale: Edge0 is a local LLM inference engine that also ships CLI, daemon and desktop/mobile apps, so scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for it. The evidence covers model serving, one-shot chat, adapters and benchmarks, but nothing about schedulers, cron-style triggers or recurring workflows. The macOS daemon and the one-shot chat command are adjacent features, not recurring scheduling.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
